name: inspira-text-hover-effect
title: Text Hover Effect
blurb: Text transforms under the cursor as you move over it.
description: Tracks pointer position and animates text distortion, rotation, or color shifts based on mouse coordinates.
use_when: Interactive headlines or accent text that should feel responsive to user input.
avoid_when: Touch-only surfaces or keyboard-nav sites — hover effects are pointless without a pointer.
a11y: Hover-driven; keyboard users cannot trigger the effect. No keyboard alternative.
